name: secsec
description: Panel control for secsec. Prompts for your SSH-key passphrase at login, runs `secsec sync` in the background (the passphrase travels over a pipe, never the command line), and shows its status. The sync keeps running while the screen is locked; the panel UI is hidden there. The folder to sync is read from secsec/ui.conf in your config directory (~/.config by default).
